introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: You can use this test without an account. Survey answers and result calculations stay in your browser. If you share a result or friend match link, MUSIC scores in the URL may reach the recipient and the hosting service that creates social previews. Advertising scripts have their own data practices.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.noCollectionContent: The service does not require a login or operate a separate database for names, email addresses, phone numbers, or raw survey answers. Score-bearing share links and ordinary web requests are exceptions to browser-only processing.
localStorageItems: Survey answers in progress are kept in browser session storage
Language settings, up to three recent results, and up to 100 local usage events are kept in browser local storage
The in-app friend comparison is restored from a URL fragment (#)
Personal and friend share links with social previews put scores in the URL query sent to a Cloudflare Pages Function
People and platforms that receive a shared link can see the scores it contains
The test does not ask for a name, email address, or phone number
thirdPartyItems: Google AdSense may process cookies, web beacons, IP addresses, and other data for advertising
Cloudflare may process request URLs while serving the site and generating share previews
Opening a Spotify album link is subject to Spotify's data practices

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.noUsageContent: The service does not operate an account or results database. Browser-stored data supports local restoration and features.
browserProcessingItems: Survey responses are processed locally to generate your personality results
Friend compatibility and shared genre recommendations are calculated from both scores in your browser
Language preferences are remembered for your convenience
Using a share link passes scores in its URL for preview generation and result restoration

thirdPartyServices.title: Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.googleAdsenseContent: We use Google AdSense to display advertisements. Google may use cookies and web beacons to collect information about your visits to this and other websites to provide targeted advertisements. You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's Ad Settings.
thirdPartyServices.noAnalyticsContent: The service records its own interaction events only in browser local storage, not on a separate analytics server. Hosting requests and Google AdSense have separate data practices.

cookies.title: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.ourStorageContent: The service uses browser session and local storage to:
ourStorageItems: Save survey progress and recent results on your device
Keep up to 100 recent local usage events and three results in local history
cookies.thirdPartyCookiesContent: Google AdSense may use cookies for advertising purposes. You can control these through your browser settings or Google's Ad Settings. Disabling cookies will not affect the core functionality of our personality test.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: Raw survey answers are processed in your browser. Creating or opening a share link passes scores in its URL, so do not send that link to someone you do not want to see it. Clearing browser storage removes progress and recent results kept on that device.

userRights.title: Your Data Control
userRights.content: You can manage data stored on your device through your browser:
controlItems: Clear browser session and local storage to remove the saved survey progress and result history on your device
Links already shared with other people or platforms are managed separately by those recipients
You can retake the test anytime without any account or registration
userRights.noTraditionalRights: Contact us below with questions about share links or advertising and hosting data practices.

childrenPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: The service does not ask for a user's age. We recommend parental guidance when children share results or open external music and advertising links.

acceptance.content: By accessing and using MUTI ("the Service"), you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by the above, please do not use this service.

serviceDescription.title: Description of Service
serviceDescription.content: MUTI is a free entertainment website. It calculates five music-taste scores from your survey answers and compares them with curated genre profiles to suggest music and playful personality notes. Results are neither a validated psychological diagnosis nor the probability that you will like a genre.
